mapper.update: UPDATE mingle_support_tickets SET answer = #{answer}, status = 'RESOLVED', answered_at = SYSDATE WHERE id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, category, title, content, status, answer, answered_at AS answeredAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM mingle_support_tickets WHERE id = #{ticketId}
